description: x402 endpoint doctor: probes a paid x402 URL unpaid (never pays) and grades it A-F: 402 on GET / HEAD / empty POST, CORS, v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and v1 body, accepts (USDC asset, EIP-712 domain, Solana feePayer, amounts, payTo), multichain consistency and the Bazaar declaration. Free preview tier: grade, score, status and counts. The paid x402 endpoints /v1/lite ($0.005), /v1/check ($0.02, adds the facilitator validate verdict, payee checks and generated fixes) and /v1/site ($0.05, whole origin) return the fix list.

method.description: Method your paid route uses (default: from its Bazaar declaration, else GET)

url.description: Full https URL of the paid x402 route (site tier: the origin or API base URL)

name: check_x402_endpoint
title: Is my x402 endpoint correct?
